#anthropic_key.title: Anthropic API Key
#anthropic_key.description: Your Anthropic API key. Required for all runs. Find it at console.anthropic.com under API Keys.

#github_token.title: GitHub Token
#github_token.description: Optional GitHub Personal Access Token (fine-grained PAT: Contents r/w, Pull Requests r/w; or classic repo scope). Required when github_enabled is true or any private plugin source is used.

model.title: Model
model.description: Claude model to use for the agent run.

fallback_model.title: Fallback Model
fallback_model.description: Optional fallback model if the primary model is unavailable.

max_turns.title: Max Turns
max_turns.description: Maximum number of agent turns per task. Combined with max_budget_usd, this bounds every run. Always set explicitly; the SDK default (None) is unbounded.

max_budget_usd.title: Max Budget (USD)
max_budget_usd.description: Hard USD cost ceiling per config run. Per-task overrides from the tasks table are clamped to this ceiling.

effort.title: Effort Level
effort.description: Optional effort/quality level hint passed to the SDK. Higher effort typically increases cost.

permission_mode.title: Permission Mode
permission_mode.description: Controls how the agent handles tool permission requests. Only non-prompting modes are available — modes that prompt for approval (default, acceptEdits, plan) would hang a headless Keboola job until timeout. dontAsk (default): deny anything not explicitly allow-listed, never prompts. bypassPermissions: auto-approve all tools; use deliberately. auto: classifier-gated auto-decision, no human prompt.

enum_titles: dontAsk — deny un-allow-listed tools, never prompt (recommended)

allowed_tools.title: Allowed Tools
allowed_tools.description: Explicit allow-list of tool names the agent may use. Built-in tools: Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Glob, Grep, WebFetch, WebSearch. Scoped patterns supported (e.g. Bash(git *)). MCP tools: mcp__<server>__<tool> or wildcard mcp__<server>__*.

disallowed_tools.title: Disallowed Tools
disallowed_tools.description: Explicit deny-list of tool names the agent may not use, regardless of permission_mode.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: Optional config-level system prompt prepended to every agent run. In tasks-table mode, a per-task system_prompt column overrides this for that row.

settings_json.title: Settings JSON
settings_json.description: Optional JSON object passed through as Claude settings (written to a file and referenced via ClaudeAgentOptions.settings). Use for advanced SDK settings passthrough.

setting_sources.title: Setting Sources
setting_sources.description: Controls which ambient settings files the agent reads. Default empty = no ambient user/project settings, ensuring isolated reproducible runs.

github_enabled.title: Enable GitHub
github_enabled.description: When enabled, allows the agent to use gh and git commands (Bash(gh *) and Bash(git *) are added to allowed_tools). Requires #github_token to be set.

github_token_note.title: GitHub Note
github_token_note.description: GitHub is enabled. Make sure #github_token is set above — it is injected as GITHUB_TOKEN and GH_TOKEN for gh and git commands.

inputAttributes.placeholder: Set #github_token above to authenticate gh and git commands.

workspace_input_files.title: Stage Input Files into Workspace
workspace_input_files.description: When true, files from /data/in/files/ are staged into the agent's working directory so the agent can read uploaded files directly.

task_id_filter.title: Task ID Filter
task_id_filter.description: Only applies in tasks-table mode (when a tasks input table is mapped). Leave empty to process all rows. Set to a single task_id or a comma-separated list to process only those rows. Use case: map one shared tasks table into multiple configs, each config owning its own row subset via this filter. A filter that matches no row fails with a clear error. Ignored in config-prompt mode (no tasks table).

task.title: Task (Config-Prompt Mode)
task.description: Used when no tasks input table is mapped. Defines the single prompt to run. In tasks-table mode, prompts come from the tasks table rows instead.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: The agent goal or prompt text for this run.

system_prompt.title: System Prompt (per-task override)
system_prompt.description: Optional per-task system prompt. Overrides the config-level system prompt for this task only.

default_incremental.title: Default Incremental Load
default_incremental.description: When true, agent-produced output tables default to incremental load mode (append). When false (default), tables are overwritten on each run.

mcp_servers.title: MCP Servers
mcp_servers.description: List of Model Context Protocol servers to make available to the agent. Each server's tools must be opted into via allowed_tools (e.g. mcp__<server>__* to allow all tools from a server).

name.title: Server Name
name.description: Identifier for this MCP server (referenced in allowed_tools as mcp__<name>__<tool>).

command.title: Command
command.description: Executable to launch the stdio server (e.g. uvx, python, npx).

args.title: Arguments
args.description: Command-line arguments for the stdio server.

env.title: Environment Variables
env.description: Environment variables injected into the stdio server process. Use #-prefixed keys (e.g. #TOKEN) for secrets — they are encrypted at rest.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: URL of the remote HTTP or SSE MCP server.

headers.title: HTTP Headers
headers.description: HTTP headers sent to the remote server (e.g. {"Authorization": "Bearer <token>"}). Use #-prefixed keys for encrypted secrets.

plugins.title: Plugins (Advanced)
plugins.description: Runtime plugin marketplaces to install at job start. Plugins are fetched into a writable /tmp location and loaded into the SDK. Public shorthands (e.g. superpowers) are resolved via a built-in registry. Private sources require #github_token.

source.title: Source
source.description: Marketplace source. Use a public shorthand (e.g. superpowers), an explicit owner/repo (e.g. keboola/cf-claude-code-kit), a git URL, or a remote marketplace.json URL.

private.title: Private Source
private.description: Mark true if this source requires authentication. Requires #github_token to be set.

private_token_note.title: Note
private_token_note.description: This plugin source is marked private. Make sure #github_token is set — it is used to authenticate the marketplace fetch.

inputAttributes.placeholder: Set #github_token above to authenticate this private plugin source.

plugins.title: Plugin Names
plugins.description: Plugin name(s) to install from this marketplace. Leave empty or use ["*"] to install all plugins the marketplace offers.

version.title: Version
version.description: latest (re-pull newest on every run, not reproducible) or a pinned tag/SHA/branch (e.g. v1.4.0, abc1234, main) for reproducible installs. The resolved version is recorded in claude_runs.

sdk_version.title: SDK Version (Advanced)
sdk_version.description: Controls which claude-agent-sdk version is used at runtime. pinned (default): use the baked 0.2.101, no network required, deterministic. A concrete version (e.g. 0.2.105): pip install at job start into /tmp/sdk-overlay, requires HTTPS egress. latest: pip install newest, requires HTTPS egress, non-reproducible (version can change between runs). The resolved version is recorded in claude_runs for traceability. Only change from pinned if you need a specific newer SDK version.

sdk_version_on_failure.title: SDK Version — On Install Failure (Advanced)
sdk_version_on_failure.description: Behaviour when a non-pinned SDK install fails (e.g. no egress, registry down, bad version string). fail (default): raise UserException so the user knows the requested version was not loaded — no silent downgrade. fallback_pinned: log a warning and continue on the baked 0.2.101.

enum_titles: fail — raise error (no silent downgrade, default)
fallback_pinned — log warning and use baked 0.2.101
